title.en: Leading Analytical Work: Review, Standards and Stakeholders
title.ar: قيادة العمل التحليلي: المراجعة والمعايير وأصحاب المصلحة

tagline: REPLACE: one line under the title: what participants can do after the course
description: Participants lead the analytics unit of the fictional Ras Sahil Ports Authority: twelve analysts whose work increasingly starts as an assistant's draft. They write a proportionate quality-assurance standard and review checklist, re-run and review colleagues' analyses, set the unit's rules for AI-assisted work, turn review findings into feedback, and negotiate scope, deadline and evidence with role-played sponsors, one of whom asks for an unfavourable result to be dropped. DS-310 teaches reviewing one analysis; this course sets the standards and runs the system.
audience: Specialists. Data scientists who have completed the level 300 core and practicum, or can show equivalent work: an analysis they led from question to recommendation and defended.
prerequisites: DS-310 Problem Framing and Analytical Review
Has reviewed an analysis written by someone else and written comments the author acted on
Uses version control for analysis code

outcomes.text: Design a proportionate quality-assurance standard for analytical work, with assurance levels, a review checklist and sign-off rules, given the unit's log of 30 requests with their uses and risks
outcomes.evidence: a standard with which a peer, working independently, assigns the same assurance levels to six new requests

outcomes.text: Review analyses by others, including assistant-drafted ones, rank findings by their effect on the decision and calibrate severity with a second reviewer, given three seeded-flaw analysis repositories
outcomes.evidence: review notes that find the seeded critical flaws, and a severity agreement table with the second reviewer

outcomes.text: Design rules for AI-assisted analysis covering verification, disclosure and the process evidence each analyst keeps, and audit the unit's work against them, given the national generative AI guidelines and a log of the unit's assisted analyses
outcomes.evidence: a one-page rule set and an audit of five assisted analyses against it

outcomes.text: Prepare feedback and a development plan for an analyst from review findings, given a reviewed notebook and the analyst's skills profile
outcomes.evidence: a feedback note and three-month plan that a peer judges specific

outcomes.text: Lead a negotiation with a sponsor on scope, deadline and evidence threshold and record the agreement, given a role-played sponsor whose constraints change during the meeting
outcomes.evidence: an analysis agreement and an observer's rubric score

outcomes.text: Decide how to respond to pressure to change or suppress a finding, and record the reasons, given a scripted request to remove an unfavourable subgroup result
outcomes.evidence: a decision record citing the unit's standard and the ethics principles
